items.note: K1 states the signed exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch value restored. K1.a.1-3 follow the proof at 744-759: net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c, central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2 or (|S∩T|-1)/2, side wires cancelling the rest. K1.b gives the three-stage composition (762-764). The wire counts W_b, W_c (767-782) and h=100 are not given, but they are not part of the lemma.

Follows 804-825 exactly: the stored array equals D_v applied to the logical array, the edge operator D_vD_u^{-1}, a common frame commuting with the pointwise gate, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}.

Wm-2N+2L, L=Ich, the decreasing edges (central wires from time 3 to 4, each losing h) and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539 are all stated correctly. The label construction is missing: F^{⊗3}, the triple-indicator vectors, the orthogonality of neighbouring triples, and the table eq:motif-labels. The residual-table verification (1012-1064) that proves comparability and finds the only decreasing edges is asserted (K3.A.2), not derived. Only the telescoping step is shown.

s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m is derived along the paper's route: rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, plus the N exceptional source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one (1158-1167). The endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m appears only as a condition in KS.frame. Its proof, P_{U_a^⊥}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m together with zero sources and identity sinks for the other roles (1169-1171), is never given, and the assignment of P_U to gates and sinks is left implicit.

The plan states that each edge's frame change is a product of one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, and that telescoping gives C^{⊗e} on every role. It never gives s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c or s_c<W_c m, and it omits the frames C_U=H^{⊗m}diag(i^{q_U})H^{⊗m}. The proof's mechanism is also missing: weight additivity mod 4 under orthogonality, H diag(1,-1) H = X, and the 27-coordinate Z_{a,k} correction on X_a->Y_a (1232-1310).

The paper's chain is reproduced: L/N<1/2 gives a positive deficit, the relative deficit exceeds 20·2^{-50}, log m<20, and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50})>m(1-eta), so s/W<m^tau. The exact values eta_b, eta_c are not given. For the complex network, the deficit 2N-2L_c and s_c/W_c<m^sigma are left implicit (used only at S3.3.e).

S2.1 states the four elementary O(V) operations correctly. S2.2 drops the hypotheses that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time and that the coefficient denominators be prime to q. Its one-line method fits only the shift: the unit multiplication uses c increasing pieces, and negation uses a stack (592-614).

The shear cost is derived faithfully (1425-1446): triangular transformations in O(V) by controlled shifts, the conjugation order, and one interchange per one of Pi. The factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 is only quoted (K4), without the elimination proof at 1375-1391. The choice of a fixed prime q avoiding the table's denominators (1413-1423) is also omitted.

Every element of the proof at 1491-1615 is present: the row split into W role streams of volume V/W, shear frames giving H<-H+D on every row, the three-update interchange, s recursive calls, the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with both cases of the geometric sum, the depth-first parking schedule, and the descriptor cost. KS's statement omits the hypothesis that the row field be divisible by W^k, which S2.3 supplies.

Follows 1649-1734: high digits rho=O(log e) used as rows with padding to a multiple of W^k, a base-m decomposition with power-width calls, the geometric cost sum, and binary padding to [q^e]. S2.3 compresses the step that joins h^+ and d^+ into a row field of range q^{2rho}>=W^k (1660-1680).

The plan states the kernel identities, the inverse-child identity, the s_c child calls on f=e/m axes, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D, all correctly. It omits the key step that turns arbitrary residual directions into coordinate slots: conjugation by P_M (eq:phase-edge-coordinate, 1849-1862), and the factorization of P_M into a fixed number of row additions by Gaussian elimination (1892-1901). These appear only as 'binary changes of basis' in S3's method.

Follows 2013-2207: eight conditional additions with the net map (u+c(1-2(u mod 2)),w), each line as one whole-chunk cyclic shift, the bad set with delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting only B, repair by radix sort, and the last position by a two-bit XOR.

Matches 2286-2445: s calls per invocation, node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), rows from the first q_0 chunks, the recurrence with leaves F(e)=O(e) for e<d^beta, the internal sum O(e^lambda), the leaf bound O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), and the base-m piece sum giving O(d^{lambda'}).

Character cancellation by index shift (2820-2825), decimation in frequency with bit-reversed storage and the reverse procedure (2832-2887), grouped rounds, and the layout L with its cost and error terms (2995-3199) are all reproduced.
Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the separation bound |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, centered-residue extraction with carries in {0,1}, and negacyclic reduction of ac-be and ae+bc all match 3236-3340.
The retained LB order, the normalization identity, P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), and the error 3delta+eta scaled by M all follow 3414-3473.

The derivation follows 3598-3642: the Gaussian identity, the Neumann-series inverse, the normalized contractions, product 2^{-2alpha^2}, then tensoring and the line and axis-exposure costs. The statement leaves out the hypotheses gcd(s,t)=1 and theta>p/alpha^4 (they reappear in S6.1.f), the explicit definitions of P_s and P_t, and the per-line error <p^2.

Both identities are stated and proved by the paper's route: the coefficient check against Q reading frequency -s_i j_i, the substitution h=ck giving RF^+R=F^+, and the convolution normalization giving (u*v)/S^2. The chirp a_j itself is not written out.

S0 only lists n-log-n-conjecture among its prerequisites. The plan never states the eventual-lower-bound formulation or the liminf argument.

errors.says: Adding an offset to a later field, or multiplying it by a fixed unit, costs O(V) by splitting each fibre into two pieces and merging them in the opposite order.
errors.paper: The two-piece split and reversed merge implements the offset shift only. Multiplication by a unit c splits each fibre into c increasing pieces selected by a residue counter, and negation reverses blocks through a stack; the lemma also requires the offset to be preparable in b^{O(1)} time.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route. Its key subtree (K1-K3, K4-K5, KS, K10) carries the bit network from the signed bank exchange, through frames, the label budget, ranks and the strict deficit, to the recurrence and O(Ve^tau); S2 extends this to all widths, S3 carries the complex analogue, and S4-S7 assemble transforms, resampling, exact recovery and the cost table. It is thinnest at three points. The label construction (F^{⊗3}, triple indicators, the residual table) is asserted rather than built. The endpoint identity I_m is used but never proved. On the complex side, the P_M change of basis, the s_c formula and the weight-additivity proof of the kernel factorization are omitted.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored and the three-element-subset gadget are carried in full. The plan never gives h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 or m=h^3; m appears only as 'an m-dimensional space'. Since the required parameters are missing, the conservative verdict applies.
Common frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate; network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}; edges cost only D_vD_u^{-1}.

The plan has nested nondegenerate labels in an m-dimensional space, every edge joining comparable labels, and the only decreasing edges being central wires from time 3 to 4, each losing h. F^{⊗3} and the triple-indicator construction are not named.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U; the N source edges 2P_{U_a} are the rank-one exceptions.
Sum of |Δdim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich; s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b as the dimension total plus N source ranks.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, give the deficit N-2L_b>0 and s_b<W_b m.
M_out(rho(w))-M_in(w)=I_m and the resulting shear H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included, are stated in their role. Why the identity holds is not shown.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls in total.
The plan has children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), tau=1-2^{-50} from deficit >20·2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving almost completely: frames, comparable labels with the single decreasing edge class, rank equal to dimension change with the N source exceptions, the budget s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, the strict deficit from L/N<1/2, the endpoint shear, rank-many recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The only shortfall is C1. The bank-exchange mechanism is fully present, but the plan never gives the fixed parameters h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3.
